settings.description: Admin settings to fill in on first start. Values an admin has set are never replaced.

signupPolicy.description: New account sign-ups. Open lets anyone register; approval holds new accounts until an admin approves them; closed refuses new accounts.

allowGuests.description: Guest sessions. Shows “Continue as guest” on the sign-in page. Turning it off signs existing guests out.

runLimits.description: Run limits. Agent runs each guest or account may start. Admins and exempt users have no limit.

perMinute.description: Runs per minute. 0 turns the window off.

perDay.description: Runs per day. 0 turns the window off.

perMinute.description: Runs per minute. 0 turns the window off.

perDay.description: Runs per day. 0 turns the window off.

enabledModels.description: Models offered. Models people can pick, from those the agent service serves. Empty offers all of them.

defaultModel.description: Default model. Model new chats start with. Unset uses the agent service's default.

autoTitle.description: Name new chats automatically. Asks the title model for a short name after the first message.

titleModel.description: Title model. Any OpenRouter model id that supports structured outputs. Pick a small, cheap one.

accountEmail.description: Account email through Resend. Applied only when none is saved yet.

senderName.description: Shown as the sender, for example “chat.richardr.dev”.

senderEmail.description: An address on a domain verified in Resend.

apiKey.description: Resend API key. Stored encrypted with BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.

title: chat.richardr.dev seed
description: Starting values for admin settings, read from RUNTIME_SEED_JSON or RUNTIME_SEED_JSON_PATH.
